description.value:
Traits Signal

Becoming deafened no longer ends your Broadcast, and you continue to gain Encore and to sustain it normally. You still suffer every other effect of being deafened, including its penalty to initiative and its effect on your own Perception. If you begin a Broadcast while already deafened, you must succeed at a DC 5 flat check or the action is lost.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB3 (modifies Broadcast's own end-conditions on a non-existent item). The DC 5 flat check to activate is a live, player-rolled gate on an action use, which real pf2e handles at the table/via the action's own description rather than a rule element — not itself a rules-array gap, but moot given SB3 blocks the file's central clause anyway.
